purpose: ADR-087 (owner 05.10.2026, 'teeme need tugevaks', item 5): do the Family Law Act's sections on who owes maintenance (§ 96) and who may receive it (§ 97) reach the evidence of a question asked in everyday words? The act says 'ülenejad ja alanejad sugulased'; a person asks about children and parents. The questions, the plan queries (the two that the measured turns of 04.10.2026 recorded, and two written here) and the deciding words of each section were fixed before any run. Compared: the same search on corpus v57 (no search aid) and on the corpus that gives the three sections their aids. No reranker and no answer model; the query texts are embedded once and kept.
